effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] When any Digimon cards with the [ADVENTURE] trait would be played from your hand, by suspending this Tamer, reduce the play cost by 1.
[Your Turn] All of your level 5 or higher Digimon with the [ADVENTURE] trait gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.).
